question: Should this backlog item enter ideation now, dispatched via a fable-model ensign per captain direction, chartered to design and choose among the three candidate ceremony-collapse mechanisms?

artifacts.summary: Applying one captain gate decision currently costs ~16 FO tool calls / 156s (measured on sonnet-gate-guardrail-no-authority's ideation->implementation gate), recurring at every nonterminal gate for every entity forever. Three candidate collapse mechanisms are proposed, ascending in weight: (1) make state commit implicit inside gate record/consume; (2) a gate approve convenience verb composing record+consume+commit for the common captain-chat-approval path; (3) a dispatch advance verb folding the post-consume frontmatter stamps and worktree creation. Ideation should choose/combine without weakening any authority or integrity check the ceremony exists to enforce.
